summary.text: Rick Walker is the Democratic candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 57 in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside Republican Jesse Styles and independent Belinda Grassi.
He has run for the Ohio House several times before, most recently in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Rick Walker was the Democratic candidate for Ohio House District 61 in 2014, 2016 and 2018.
Incumbent Ron Young defeated him in 2014 and 2016, and Jamie Callender defeated him in 2018.
In 2024 Walker ran in District 57, where incumbent Jamie Callender defeated him, 62.6 percent to 37.4 percent.
In a 2018 Ballotpedia survey, Walker listed his top three priorities as fair funding for public schools, fair funding for local municipalities and finding solutions for the heroin epidemic.
Walker advanced from the Democratic primary for District 57 on May 5, 2026.
